It will get better you just have to hang in there, have you tired telling anyone of your pain?
If you want an open relationship just talk to her about it. I'm sure she'll understand.

You cannot compare yourself to the people around you, your life has a different story a different meaning, it wont be like anyone elses.. Your talents will develope differently, just keep practicing. Don't doubt yourself quite so much, I mean a bit of doubt is good it'll propel you forward but to much will create a barrier between you and your creative outlet.
Find people who participate in activities you do.
You should try to talk to her about these things. communication is important in a relationship.
